[[File:HalleBurtoni-TCWCE.png|thumb|right|250px|Halle Burtoni walked with a cane]]
{{Otheruses|Cane}}
A '''cane''' was an object utilized to assist an individual in walking. They could also be a symbol of high rank or status.

Several well known beings in the galaxy made use of a cane, including [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]<ref name="TESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>. [[Halle Burtoni/Legends|Halle Burtoni]], an elderly [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] from [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] also made use of a cane to assist her movement in her old age.<ref name="TCWCE">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] leader, [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]], walked with a cane known as the [[Staff of Command/Legends|Staff of Command]], which symbolized his authority as [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]].<ref name="TCWCE" /> [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|Notluwiski Papanoida's]] cane seemed to serve as a symbol of affluence, as he was perfectly mobile with out it and did not require it to walk.<ref name="SOI">{{TCW|Sphere of Influence}}</ref><ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

While [[Grand Master/Legends|Master]] Yoda used a simple [[Gimer stick/Legends|cane]] made from [[Gimer bush|Gimer wood]], other elderly [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] fashioned their canes to serve a double purpose - both walking aide and [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. The blind [[Veknoid/Legends|Veknoid]] Jedi Master [[Zao]] fashioned his walking cane to act as the [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|hilt]] of his [[Long-handle lightsaber|lightsaber]].<ref name="Darkness">''[[Star Wars: Darkness]]''</ref> Similarly, [[Tera Sinube/Legends|Tera Sinube]], a male [[Cosian/Legends|Cosian]] Jedi Master, created [[Tera Sinube's sabercane|his lightsaber]] hilt as the detachable handle of his [[Sabercane/Legends|cane]].<ref name="TCWCE" /><ref name="LL">{{TCW|Lightsaber Lost}}</ref>

The former [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]]-turned-[[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]], [[Fi Skirata]], disliked the idea of using a cane during his recovery from a traumatic [[Brain/Legends|brain]] [[Battle of Gaftikar|injury]]. In lieu of a cane, Skirata's girlfriend [[Parja Bralor]] provided the wounded [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] with a traditional Mandalorian hunting [[Spear/Legends|spear]] known as a ''[[bevii'ragir]]'' to act as a walking stick, which he found to be more dignified than a cane or crutches.<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>

During the conflict known as the [[Battle for Endor]], the human known as [[Noa Briqualon]] used his cane in a fierce duel against the [[Sanyassan Marauder]] King [[Terak]], who wielded a sword. Terak managed to slice Briqualon's cane in two with his sword, but Briqualon's allies intervened before the Sanyassan could kill the elderly human.<ref>Ewoks: The Battle for Endor</ref>

In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]] during [[Second Galactic Civil War]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] had a silver-tipped black cane.<ref name="Exile">''[[Legacy of the Force: Exile]]''</ref>
